concerns.text: FR-012 requires storing degradation‑curve shape and maximum‑derivative data in `data/derived/curve_shape.parquet`, but no task in tasks.md creates or validates this artifact.
FR-018 mandates realism validation against the DNS‑Challenge dataset; there is no task that performs this validation or logs its results.
FR-032 calls for an initial power‑analysis (G*Power) and logging of the required sample size, yet no task addresses power‑analysis.
FR-032‑VERIF requires re‑running G*Power after the final sample size is fixed and recording achieved power; no task covers this verification step.
FR-033 specifies creation of a manually‑annotated validation subset (500 stress curves) and generation of `data/derived/manual_collapse.parquet`; no task creates this subset or artifact.
FR-035 demands a partial‑correlation analysis controlling for transcript‑difficulty; tasks.md contains no task performing this analysis.
SC-009 requires measuring precision ≥ 0.90 and recall ≥ 0.90 of deterministic collapse‑point identification against expert ground truth, but no task computes or validates these metrics.
The plan references FR‑053 (spline inflection) which does not exist in the specification, indicating a naming inconsistency.
